parts.question: Compare adverse-event evidence in hn-204 and HN-402 for nausea

result.answer: In HN-204, the treatment-emergent adverse event of nausea occurs in 12.7% of the AX-17 group and 6.0% of the control group, and is not serious [E1] [E3]. In HN-402, nausea occurs in 14.1% of the AX-17 group and 6.0% of the control group, and is not serious [E2] [E3]. The treatment % for HN-402 minus HN-204 is +1.4 points, and the control % difference is +0.0 points [E4]. The treatment % minus control % for nausea is +6.7 points in HN-204 and +8.1 points in HN-402 [E4].
